title: Legal Financial Markets
full_description:
ING Legal Wholesale Banking in Brussels is seeking anenthusiastic and pragmaticlawyer to join the Legal Financial Markets team, an international team of highly skilled lawyers, as a capital markets lawyer.
The Legal Financial Markets team consists of 4 international lawyerswith a global experience in capital markets and derivatives.
We also form a virtual team with legal colleagues in London, Amsterdam, Singapore, New York, and Frankfurt.
The Capital Markets lawyers of the team are responsible for supporting (global) capital markets (DCM, ABS, ECM), treasury, corporate finance and corporate investment departments in ING.
We contribute to various innovation initiatives such as automation and AI tools integration.
We participate in legal committees of (international) banking associations.
Our team is part of ING Legal WB, supporting ING wholesale business lines.
Roles and responsibilities
You will be responsible for advising the GCM (DCM, ECM, ABS) and CF bankers on legal and documentation matters related to bond issues, IPOs, secondary offerings, share buybacks, securitizations and other structured finance transactions;
You will support the issuance of vanilla and structured products for public and private investors;
Answer a wide variety of questions from bankers and outside counsel that arise during a transaction;
Drafting of contracts such as NDAs, Engagement Letters, and Final Terms for private placements;
Review and negotiate underwriting agreements, subscription agreements, legal opinions, comfort letters, and other transaction documents;
Horizon scanning of regulatory developments regarding Prospectus Regulation, MIFID, MAR, ESG, and others;
Contact and instruct external parties, such as outside legal counsel; and
Identify and manage legal and reputational risk.
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Minimum experience of 4-6 years as a lawyer or in-house counsel at a bank in the field of capital markets, corporate Law, or M&A;
A Master's degree in Law from a reputable university (Belgian Law preferred);
Transaction management skills;
Proven ability to work in larger teams/organizations;
Strong analytical skills and is pragmatic, flexible, and a good communicator;
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English; and
The ability to prioritize multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
●A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement for more information. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button.
Please note, multiple interview steps involving various business stakeholders will be part of the selection process.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
